claims.claim_text: K2 用約 1 秒的 p99 寫入延遲換掉 broker 維運，GitHub 為了效能反而多送 CSS，turbopuffer 把向量索引降成次級索引來壓寫入放大
claims.evidence: about 1 second of produce latency at the 99th percentile | making ANN 'just another' secondary index | Updating just one vector can move hundreds of attributes and their indexes
claims.note: Each part is backed by its item's source. See c04, c14, c15 and c27. The 'broker 維運' framing is the author's own.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 推出 K2，一個建在 R2 物件儲存上的 serverless 事件串流服務
claims.evidence: K2 is a durable event streaming primitive on the Developer Platform ... on top of R2 object storage
claims.note: The fetched text says 'durable event streaming primitive' and does not use the word 'serverless'. It is low-risk as a description of a Developer Platform service.

claims.claim_text: 用「在中間插入一個吸收寫入的服務」讓生產者與消費者各走各的步調
claims.evidence: decoupling our producers and consumers — inserting a service in the middle that absorbs writes while allowing independent readers to consume at their own pace

claims.claim_text: 因為要批次寫入來繞過物件儲存的限制，produce 延遲在 p99 約 1 秒
claims.evidence: this adds up to about 1 second of produce latency at the 99th percentile ... writing to object storage is slower than a local disk, and we have to wait for the local batch to accumulate

claims.claim_text: 目前 beta 提供給 Workers Paid 使用者，每個 stream 上限 10GB 儲存與每秒 30 MB 寫入
claims.evidence: K2 is available today in public beta for accounts with Workers Paid subscriptions ... 10GB of storage used ... 30 MB/s produce per stream

claims.claim_text: beta 後的預期定價是每 GB 0.04 美元
claims.evidence: Data Produced $0.04 / GB, Data Consumed $0.04 / GB, Data Retained $0.02 / GB / month
claims.note: The source gives $0.04/GB for both produced and consumed data. The lede leaves out the $0.02/GB/month retention price. That makes it incomplete but not false.

claims.claim_text: 容器啟動時間中位數從 4.049 秒降到 648 毫秒，約快 6 倍
claims.evidence: | Median | 4.049 seconds | 648 milliseconds | 6.2x faster |
claims.note: The source credits ComputeSDK's independent benchmark for these figures.

claims.claim_text: 壓力測試中能在數秒內建出數十萬個容器
claims.evidence: In our own preliminary tests, burst testing successfully created hundreds of thousands of containers in seconds.
claims.note: The source calls the tests 'preliminary', and its one quantified result is 100,000 containers in 5.387s. The lede is supported.

claims.claim_text: 開發者現在可以在執行時才決定每個沙盒的映像與實例類型，檔案系統快照也進入 public beta
claims.evidence: Your code can now choose each sandbox's image and instance type at runtime ... filesystem snapshots are available in public beta

claims.claim_text: Matthew Green 檢視公開事件後主張，代理要有用就得碰資料、工具與網路，所以完美隔離本來就做不到
claims.evidence: you _can't_ perfectly isolate agents, at least not if you expect them to do useful things.
claims.note: Green discusses public incidents at OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

claims.claim_text: 用「監看模型」去盯代理則只是把安全問題換了形式
claims.evidence: a warden-guarded sandbox is just another version of the alignment problem. You're going to have to trust a model to do it

claims.claim_text: 更被忽略的威脅不是代理逃出沙盒，而是一群從不離開沙盒、卻對任何下指令的人言聽計從的代理，prompt injection 正是入口
claims.evidence: a swarm of perfectly amenable agents that never leave their sandboxes, each doing exactly what it's told ... agents will do what they're told by whoever manages to get text in front of them

claims.claim_text: turbopuffer 在 v3 把 ANN 向量索引降為「另一種次級索引」，不再讓它主導文件的儲存方式
claims.evidence: making ANN 'just another' secondary index ... a new primary index structure that doesn't constrain document storage layout

claims.claim_text: 更新一個向量，可能因 SPFresh 的重新平衡而牽動文件上數百個屬性與索引
claims.evidence: Updating just one vector can move hundreds of attributes and their indexes
claims.note: The source ties this to SPFresh rebalancing.

claims.claim_text: 以 256 篇文件為區塊的 FTS v2 做出約 10 倍小的索引與最高 20 倍快的查詢
claims.evidence: The index got 10x smaller and queries got up to 20x faster ... fixed blocks of approximately 256 documents

claims.claim_text: v3 目前通過 100% 的 CI，效能追平前不會上線
claims.evidence: 100% of CI passes on turbopuffer v3 ... delaying production rollout until achieving performance parity

claims.claim_text: 去掉傳統 ring 演算法的中繼跳數，改用 DMA 引擎搬資料以避免佔用運算資源，並壓低同步延遲
claims.evidence: removes the relay hops of traditional ring algorithm, moves data through DMA engines to avoid compute resource contention, and minimizes synchronization latency

claims.claim_text: 在 RTX 4090 與 RTX 5090 上整合進 vLLM、測三個常見 MoE 模型，dispatch 比 NCCL 快 2.00 倍、combine 快 1.53 倍
claims.evidence: average speedups of 2.00× and 1.53× over NCCL for dispatch and combine ... integrated into vLLM and evaluated on three MoE models using RTX 4090 and RTX 5090
claims.note: These are averages in the source. Adding 平均 to the lede is optional.

claims.claim_text: 端到端最高比現有最佳 MoE 推論框架快 1.66 倍
claims.evidence: Abstract: 'up to 1.66× end-to-end speedup over state-of-the-art MoE inference frameworks'.
claims.note: The source's 'up to' is dropped, so a best case is presented as a general result. Fix: 端到端最高快 1.66 倍.

claims.claim_text: GitButler 的文章反對 Git 3.0 即將改預設為 SHA-256，理由是 SHA-1 意外碰撞在實務上不會發生，真正的攻擊多半靠社交工程而非破解雜湊
claims.evidence: Git 3.0 will make SHA-256 the new default ... avoidable global nightmare ... this has never happened ... it currently happens in the real world because someone socially engineers an exploit

claims.claim_text: SHA-1 與 SHA-256 的儲存庫無法混用
claims.evidence: Every project will now be in one bucket or the other and they cannot be mixed.

claims.claim_text: 作者預期使用者建庫時得自己搞清楚該選哪一種格式，勢必造成困擾
claims.evidence: Author: users 'need to know what version of git they ran git init with' and choose the right one.
claims.note: The source predicts frustration and says users must know and choose correctly. It never says users will commonly choose wrong. Fix: 作者預期使用者得自己搞清楚並選對格式，勢必造成困擾.

claims.claim_text: 提議像 git-evtag 那樣另加獨立的 tree hash 標頭，不必動全生態
claims.evidence: Colin Walters' git-evtag has done almost exactly this since 2015 ... adds a Git-EVTag-v0-SHA512 checksum ... verified independently from the SHA-1

claims.claim_text: 過去兩個月 629 個 benchmark 中 555 個變快，平均 wall-time 減少 4.57%
claims.evidence: of the 629 benchmark measurements, 555 of them improved ... The mean wall-time reduction was 4.57%, which is a remarkable improvement in just two months.

claims.claim_text: 升級到 LLVM 23（平均約 1.2%）、為 Clippy 開啟 PGO（最佳情況快 18%）
claims.evidence: The mean wall-time reduction across all benchmarks was 1.2% ... enabled PGO for Clippy ... in the best case by 18%!

claims.claim_text: 改動 dataflow 分析的 CFG 走訪方式，讓 cranelift-codegen 的 check build 少了約 30% 時間
claims.evidence: the new algorithm requires 90,000. This gave an enormous ~30% wall-time reduction for a `check` build of this crate.
claims.note: The source identifies the crate as cranelift-codegen.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 在 2026 年 6 月讓 github.com 全面改用 CSS Modules，移除 styled-components、styled-system 與 sx prop
claims.evidence: GitHub has been running on 100% CSS modules as of June 2026 ... removed `sx`, `styled-components`, and `styled-system` from dotcom

claims.claim_text: 伺服器端渲染一個頁面的時間少了 55%，頁面上元件的初始化時間少了 25%
claims.evidence: 55% less time to server-side render a page ... 25% less time for components on a page to initialize

claims.claim_text: sx prop 的用量從約 7,760 處降到 0，過程靠 feature flag 與視覺回歸測試分批上線
claims.evidence: a peak of ~7,760 `sx` props to be migrated ... Add the component to a feature flag ... Use existing visual regression tests to verify snapshots were identical

claims.claim_text: 物理學教授 Matthew Schwartz 在 Anthropic 的客座文章中介紹 BootLoops 工具組
claims.evidence: In this guest post, Prof. Matthew Schwartz returns ... BootLoops: a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science
claims.note: The fetched text does not say his field outright. Physics is clear from context: scattering amplitudes at the LHC are his 'home turf'. Low risk.

claims.claim_text: 找出「Claude-shaped」的問題，再與各領域專家合作把初步結果轉成研究貢獻
claims.evidence: allowed Claude to find 'Claude-shaped' problems ... Claude was technically correct, but the result was not all that interesting until the expert helped steer us.

claims.claim_text: 成果橫跨生態學、群體遺傳學、系統發生學等十餘個領域，包括解出先前難解的積分
claims.evidence: ecology, population genetics, and a dozen other fields ... 30 integrals BootLooped ... 15 that had never before been computed
claims.note: 'Never before computed' supports 先前難解 at roughly the same strength.

claims.claim_text: Qwen3.8-27B 是 Apache 2.0 授權的 27B 密集模型，64 層中交錯使用 Gated DeltaNet 與 Gated Attention
claims.evidence: License: apache-2.0 ... Number of Parameters: 27B ... 16 × (3 × (Gated DeltaNet → FFN) → 1 × (Gated Attention → FFN))

claims.claim_text: 原生支援圖像與影片，脈絡長度原生 262,144、可延伸到 1,000,000 tokens
claims.evidence: 262,144 natively and extensible up to 1,000,000 tokens ... Causal Language Model with Vision Encoder

claims.claim_text: 模型卡自報 SWE-bench Pro 61.7%、GPQA Diamond 89.2；思考模式預設開啟，可依請求關閉
claims.evidence: SWE-bench Pro 61.7 ... GPQA Diamond 89.2 ... Thinking mode is on by default ... "enable_thinking": False
claims.note: The lede labels these scores as self-reported, which matches the model card.
